mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 200 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k in the prior month) is a consistent indicator of robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 110 signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in retail sales (RSAFS > 350,000) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS > 130,000) indicates broad-based economic momentum that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a Federal Reserve hiking cycle (FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last 3 months), a federal funds rate above 4.5% is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during Fed hiking cycles when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
